function.name: weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified location and date, including temperature, precipitation, and wind conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographic location for the forecast, in the format 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'London, UK'.

date.description: The date for which the forecast is being retrieved, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

temperature_unit.description: The unit of measurement for temperature.

include_humidity.description: Whether to include humidity percentage in the forecast.

include_wind.description: Whether to include wind speed and direction in the forecast.

Shashi Tej Reddy is an Indian politician who has been active in national politics for several decades. Born on 12 April 1955, he entered public life through the Indian National Congress (INC) and served as a Member of Parliament in both houses—first in the Lok Sabha representing the Nalgonda constituency (1998–2009), then in the Rajya Sabha (2010–2016). During his tenure with the INC, he held ministerial positions, notably as Minister of State for Finance and Minister of State for External Affairs.

In 2017, after a period of political realignment, Reddy joined the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). He has also been associated with the Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS) at various points in his career. His political journey has seen him switch between parties, reflecting broader shifts in Telangana’s regional politics.

Reddy’s career has not been without controversy. In 2012, he was arrested on charges related to the alleged procurement of a luxury car for the Indian Army—a case that drew significant media attention. He was released on bail in 2013, but the incident remains a notable episode in his public life.

Overall, Shashi Tej Reddy is recognized as a seasoned politician whose roles have spanned legislative duties, ministerial responsibilities, and party leadership across multiple major political parties in India.
